avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces abiraterone plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; switch to alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases abiraterone levels and toxicity risk

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease abiraterone bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Use alternative immune support or separate dosing by 2+ hours

caution_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild androgen pathway interaction; may have additive hormonal effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for side effects; discuss with prescriber before use

caution_supplements.name: Licorice Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mineralocorticoid effects; abiraterone requires concurrent prednisone
caution_supplements.action: Use sparingly; monitor blood pressure and electrolytes

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases abiraterone exposure and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid; counsel patient on all grapefruit products including pomelo and Seville oranges

avoid_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases abiraterone absorption 5-10 fold, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach (1 hour before or 2 hours after food); follow strict administration guidelines

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (Broccoli, Cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Indole-3-carbinol may weakly induce CYP3A4; clinically minor interaction
caution_foods.action: Normal consumption acceptable; no dietary restriction needed

monitoring_notes: Abiraterone requires strict fasting administration and concurrent prednisone therapy; monitor for hypokalemia, hypertension, and fluid retention. Assess liver function and testosterone suppression regularly, particularly if CYP3A4 interactions are suspected.
